name: Micromajig Maker
subtitle: the little ones nag the loudest
rules: When this card enters play, you may put a Micromajig token into play. -- (Treat Micromajig tokens as Gearsmith character cards with 1 strength, 1 life, and 3 speed. If a Micromajig token would leave play, remove it from the game instead.)
notes: Catalog reminder text adds the 'majig' subtype to the token and says 'When a Micromajig token leaves play, it disappears'; the card prints neither (no majig subtype, 'would leave play, remove it from the game instead').

notes: Catalog: 'deploy' / 'each opponent' / 'threshold' / 'extra costs'; card: 'play' / 'your opponent' / 'proper resource icons' / 'additional costs'.

name: Jo Ciendeilio

name: Runic Cannon
subtitle: i don't care how much it costs...kill it!
rules: LOAD -- COST – Pay 3. -- EFFECT – Put a token on this card. -- FIRE -- COST – Deplete this card. Pick a character. -- EFFECT – Inflict X damage to the character, where X is the number of tokens on this card. Remove all tokens from this card.
notes: A 'WHY?' speech bubble is part of the artwork.
